# Synthetic MusiCNN reference

`musicnn-synthetic.csv` contains numeric output, not music, model weights, or Essentia source. Input is generated by the accompanying small API client: sample `i` is `((i % 17) - 8) / 16`, at lengths 1, 255, 256, 257, 512, 513 and 1024. Columns are input length, frame index, four frame samples (indices 0, 255, 256, 511), then all 96 output bands. SHA-256: `4c49109e97f346649f48163b0daba442c999a1118da9b8fd63c00f189f4e62b1`.

Generated with Essentia commit `36ec3d929402d491cbbb1120c54631e8c205b0ff`, using its C++ FrameCutter and TensorflowInputMusiCNN APIs, FFTW float backend. Essentia is AGPL-3.0-or-later; it is not included or linked by this crate. The accompanying generator is an original API client; no Essentia implementation is copied into it. It requires a separately obtained Essentia build. This provenance is not a grant of rights to Essentia, its models, or any other assets. No model or musical recording is used. Confirm any applicable distribution obligations separately.

The reference build's observed configure command was `./waf configure --lightweight=fftw --fft=FFTW --prefix=PREFIX --std=c++17` followed by `./waf build`; Eigen 3 and FFTW float development files are needed. With `ESS` pointing to that checkout/build and `EIGEN_INCLUDE` to the directory containing `unsupported/Eigen`, the following generator compile and run was independently repeated on the reference host:

```sh
g++ -std=c++17 -I"$EIGEN_INCLUDE" -I"$ESS/src" -I"$ESS/src/essentia" \
  crates/kima-ml/tests/fixtures/musicnn-reference.cpp -L"$ESS/build/src" \
  -Wl,-rpath,"$ESS/build/src" -lessentia -o musicnn-reference
./musicnn-reference > musicnn-synthetic.csv
sha256sum musicnn-synthetic.csv
```

The offline Rust test compares all 2,016 values with absolute tolerance 2e-5; on the reference host its largest observed error was 5.85e-6. The allowance accommodates float arithmetic and FFT implementation differences and is not a guarantee across all signals or platforms. This synthetic test does not exercise a real model or establish the binding >=0.999 model-output parity gate.
